svg.aria-label: crucible: Register a thesis, measure each claim, name the weakest axis. Seven measured axes fan out from a bright core inside fine rings. One axis falls short of the dashed tolerance ring and is marked DRIFT; one has no measurement and is marked UNVERIFIABLE.
